youtube.title: 115 People Vanished and Left One Word Behind | The Lost Colony of Roanoke
youtube.description:
In August 1590, John White returned to Roanoke Island to find the colony he had left three years earlier, including his own granddaughter Virginia Dare, completely gone. No bodies, no graves, just the word CROATOAN carved into a post. Here is the full story, from the failed first colony to the war that kept White away, what he found, and the latest archaeological theories.
